title: A new online dynamic nomogram based on the inflammation burden index to predict cardiac injury after antitumor therapy in lung cancer patients.
summary: The primary article develops and internally validates a dynamic nomogram using machine-learning/statistical predictors for one-year cardiac injury risk after antitumor therapy in 1,386 lung-cancer patients. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
ai_technology: Machine-learning/statistical modeling identifies predictors and builds the online nomogram.
organization: Department of Cardiology, The Affiliated Hospital of Xuzhou Medical University, Xuzhou, China

evidence.tested: Training and validation AUC values of 0.85 and 0.86 are reported for cardiac-injury prediction.
evidence.unknown: The retrospective cohort includes explicit internal validation and clinical-utility analyses.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning/statistical modeling identifies predictors and builds the online nomogram.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
